subject: Billing & Burst: clarified pricing bands + next steps

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: quick pricing/checklist for burst and quotas

Hi Samir — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and items we agreed to follow up on so your finance/infra folks can evaluate: 

1) Expected monthly token profile (Q2 pilot):
   - Baseline: ~15M tokens/day (inference + embeddings), ~450M tokens/month
   - Peak bursts: short spikes up to 120M tokens/day for 2–6 hours (event-driven)

2) Budget target: BrightScale is aiming for $700–900 / 1M tokens as a target unit cost for the pilot (inclusive of burst handling). You mentioned a stretch budget if we can guarantee <100ms p99 for short sequences.

3) Rate limits & overage model we discussed:
   - Soft quota: applied daily; auto-notify at 80%
   - Burst allowance: short bursts (+2x baseline) free up to a rolling 6-hour window per day, beyond that overage applies
   - Overage pricing: flat per-1M token rate above quota; we agreed to provide a sample grid with 3 price bands (low/med/high volume)

Next steps from Redwood: we'll send a sample billing grid tied to the RDW-4521 pilot, include suggested guardrails for burst windows and throttling policies, and give an estimate workbook for projected spend across the pilot months.

Attached: a one-page map of the pilot (BrightScale-MAP.pdf) and a blank estimate workbook (SAM-Prod-estimate.xlsx) we'll use for your finance team.

Can you confirm the budget band above and whether accounts@brightscale.ai should be on future threads for procurement?

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

+1 415-555-0132

Camila — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few points from our side: 

- Budget band: our procurement prefers to see a baseline estimate at $800 / 1M tokens and a stress-case at $1,100 / 1M tokens to approve headroom. The $700 number is optimistic but possible if we get committed throughput credits.
- Bursts: the product team needs a hard definition of the "rolling 6-hour window" (start of window, reset behavior). If you can outline an exact algorithm/definition we'll include it in our SRE review.
- Throttling: we'd need a configurable HTTP rate-limit header so our gateway can surface 429s to users gracefully.

Can you have the estimate workbook back to us by EOD Monday? CCing accounts for procurement visibility.

Samir, Camila — Marcus from pricing here. Thanks for the signal on target $/1M. A few clarifying points so the workbook we send matches procurement expectations: 

- Overage banding proposal (example):
  * Tier A (<= 1B tokens/mo): $950 / 1M tokens
  * Tier B (1B–3B tokens/mo): $850 / 1M tokens
  * Tier C (>3B tokens/mo): $700 / 1M tokens

  These are illustrative; for RDW-4521 pilot (~0.45B/mo) the likely published rate would sit between Tier A and Tier B depending on committed baseline.

- Burst handling: we can formalize a 6-hour rolling window defined as: any contiguous 6-hour period; the rolling window is evaluated per-account UTC-aligned but starts on first burst event for a day for accounting. We will include exact pseudo-code in the SRE note.

- Throttle headers: Redwood supports standard Retry-After and a custom X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining header; we can make both configurable at the route level for your gateway integration.

Camila will send the populated workbook and a short SRE note with pseudo-code and header examples to accounts and the product team. Marcus
